documents.title: Eligibility
documents.text: Healthy adult participants aged 18 to 55 years were eligible for enrollment. Key exclusion criteria included clinically significant cardiac disease and recent use of any investigational product.

documents.title: Dosing
documents.text: CP-101 was administered as a single oral dose in the fasted state. Dose levels of 10, 30, and 100 mg were evaluated in sequential ascending cohorts.

documents.title: Adverse events
documents.text: In the safety population of 24 participants, 19 participants (79.2%) experienced at least one treatment-emergent adverse event. The most frequently reported preferred term was headache, in 6 participants (25.0%). No serious adverse events were reported.

documents.title: Pharmacokinetics
documents.text: Following a single dose, maximum plasma concentration was reached at a median time of 1.5 hours. The mean terminal half-life was approximately 7.8 hours. Exposure increased in an approximately dose-proportional manner across the studied range.
